title: LawngNLI: A Long-Premise Benchmark for In-Domain Generalization from Short to Long Contexts and for Implication-Based Retrieval

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models fine-tuned on hypotheses only or premises only to detect spurious correlations and annotation artifacts associated with the labels.
Comparing model performance evaluated on automatic labels versus human-validated gold labels to estimate bias introduced by the dataset's automatic labeling process.
